title: Pilgrimage and Sacred Journeys
welcome_lead: Pack your bags for a journey to the world's most sacred sites.
meta_desc: KS3 Religious Studies adventure on pilgrimage across world religions.
final_note: You've journeyed in spirit to some of the world's holiest pilgrimage destinations.

concepts.def: Religious journey to a holy place.
Islamic pilgrimage to Mecca, a Pillar of Islam.
Holiest city in Islam, in Saudi Arabia.
Holy city for Jews, Christians and Muslims.
Sacred Hindu city on the River Ganges.

walkthroughs.body_html: Every Muslim who is able should make the Hajj pilgrimage to Mecca at least once in their lifetime. Millions of pilgrims gather there each year, wearing simple white clothes to show equality before God.
Christians visit places linked to Jesus like Jerusalem and Bethlehem, or sites of miracles such as Lourdes in France. Walking the Camino de Santiago in Spain is another popular pilgrimage.
Hindus bathe in the River Ganges at Varanasi to wash away sins. Sikhs visit the Golden Temple in Amritsar. Buddhists travel to Bodh Gaya, where the Buddha gained enlightenment.
